scope: Academic English translation of the corrected Spanish editions, preserving scientific content and claim scope. No new scientific audit or modification of the Spanish editions.

structural_comparison.labels: Preserved in their original sequence in every active source counterpart.
accepted_differences: In the shared complete analytic-alpha reader, the first two references exchange order to follow the English sentence; neither target is lost. This occurs in IV and V.
Article V equation 5.2 uses an inner aligned environment to wrap the identical rational value and decimal representation across two lines. All equation content and its label are retained.

mathematical_fragment_comparison.method: The compare_math.py regular-expression inventory was read and reviewed alongside the translation and local source preservation checks. It is a comparison aid, not a general TeX parser or a formal proof.
accepted_difference_classes: English prose inside text, hbox and descriptive roman fields of equations and diagrams.
Spanish operator name mcm translated as the standard English lcm, preserving arguments and values.
Sentence punctuation adjacent to inline and displayed mathematical expressions.
Identical inline mathematical expressions reordered to follow English grammar in registro_imagen_integral.tex.
The line-wrap-only aligned environment in Article V equation 5.2.
TikZ text captured by the simple dollar-delimiter parser after a double-backslash line break; the actual diagrams and mathematical labels were separately preserved and visually reviewed.
mathematical_fragment_comparison.fragment_counts: The Spanish and English fragment counts agree in each reported file.

editorial_preservation: Complete developments, definitions, hypotheses, theorem and proof blocks, displayed formulae, figure labels, introductions and conclusions translated.
Scientific claims and their qualifications retained, without strengthening, weakening or adding priority claims.
Mathematical notation, stable program interfaces and code/data retained; typography adapted to English line lengths.
English README, reproduction instructions and supplement-scope documentation supplied.
Previous Spanish receipts preserved explicitly as provenance, not relabelled as English outcomes.
